fields.climate: tropical; heavy year-round rainfall, especially in the eastern islands; located on southern edge of the typhoon belt with occasionally severe damage
fields.terrain: islands vary geologically from high mountainous islands to low, coral atolls; volcanic outcroppings on Pohnpei, Kosrae, and Chuuk
fields.resources: timber, marine products, deep-seabed minerals, phosphate
fields.farm: coconuts, cassava, vegetables, sweet potatoes, bananas, pork, plantains, fruits, beef, eggs
fields.industries: tourism, construction; specialized aquaculture, craft items (shell and wood)
fields.languages: English (official and common language), Chuukese, Kosrean, Pohnpeian, Yapese, Ulithian, Woleaian, Nukuoro, Kapingamarangi
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 54.7%, Protestant 41.1% (includes Congregational 38.5%, Baptist 1.1%, Seventh Day Adventist 0.8%, Assembly of God 0.7%), Church of Jesus Christ 1.5%, other 1.9%, none 0.7%, unspecified…

system.text: federal republic in free association with the US

fields.legal: mixed system of common and customary law
